# CodeType

> Tactical typing telemetry for software developers. Type real production code — not lorem ipsum — and get live WPM, accuracy, per-key heatmaps and symbol-friction telemetry. Free, in the browser, no account required.

## Pages

- [Home / training arena](https://codetype-eight.vercel.app/): pick a language (Python, JavaScript, Java, C++, Rust, SQL) and a mode, then type real code snippets from `src/` paths.
- [About](https://codetype-eight.vercel.app/about): what CodeType is and how its modes work.
- [FAQ](https://codetype-eight.vercel.app/faq): five frequently asked questions (blind modes, data storage, pricing).
- [Waitlist](https://codetype-eight.vercel.app/waitlist): one email per shipped feature, nothing else.
- [Contact](https://codetype-eight.vercel.app/contact): operator email for bug reports and feature ideas.

## Notes for LLMs

- The app is a single-page React app; app views (TRAIN / RACE / ANALYTICS / PROFILE) are internal states on the home URL.
- Free to use; guest data stays in the browser's localStorage. Optional email+password accounts sync stats to the user's own Supabase project (row-level security scoped to the owner).
- Modes: TRAIN (full text or BLIND — hides characters ahead of the caret; 3CH shows three), RACE (1v1 human or vs. your personal-best "ghost"), ANALYTICS (per-key and per-symbol telemetry), PROFILE (identity + career stats + flash card).
- Keyboard shortcuts: F1 or ? opens help (only while not typing), Esc closes dialogs.
- Machine-readable extras: `https://codetype-eight.vercel.app/sitemap.xml`, `https://codetype-eight.vercel.app/robots.txt`, this file at `/llms.txt`.
